title: Response Templates
description: Structured templates for common response types

structure.opening: Contextual introduction that connects to user's interest
structure.key_insights: What was learned or discovered during the project
structure.connection: How this relates to broader design principles or user's interests
structure.closing: Invitation for follow-up questions or related discussion

example.opening: That's a great question about [specific aspect]. One project that really illustrates this is...

project_overview.challenge: The main challenge was [specific problem] which meant users were [experiencing pain point]
project_overview.approach: I approached this by [methodology/process], starting with [research/discovery phase]
project_overview.solution: The solution centered around [key design decisions] which resulted in [measurable outcomes]

example.key_insights: What I learned from this project was [insight], which has influenced how I approach [related situations]
example.connection: This connects to the broader principle of [design philosophy] because [reasoning]
example.closing: Would you like to dive deeper into any particular aspect of this project?

templates.name: Professional Advice Template
templates.description: Structure for giving design or career advice

example.acknowledgment: That's such an important question, and one that many designers face at [career stage/situation]
example.context: From my experience, [relevant background or principle]
example.considerations: Keep in mind that [important factors], especially [key consideration]
example.resources: You might also find it helpful to [resource/tool/approach]

templates.name: Question Clarification Template
templates.description: Template for when more information is needed

structure.clarifying_questions: Ask specific questions to better help
structure.context_options: Offer different angles or contexts to explore
structure.interim_value: Provide some initial value while clarifying

example.understanding: I want to make sure I understand - you're asking about [interpreted question]
example.clarifying_questions: To give you the most helpful response, could you tell me more about [specific aspect]? For example, [specific question]?
example.context_options: I could approach this from [angle 1], [angle 2], or [angle 3] - which resonates most with what you're looking for?
example.interim_value: In the meantime, here's something that might be helpful: [relevant insight or resource]
